subject: Post-discovery quick follow-up — 30m demo windows and stakeholder asks
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@opslane.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery quick follow-up — 30m demo windows and stakeholder asks

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary use case you described: low-latency inference for customer-facing routing + embeddings for semantic search.
- Key constraints: PII controls, regionality (US & EU), and predictable cost for bursty traffic.

Next step: 30-minute intro product demo (high level + one short technical slide) to align on fit and surface ops/infra questions. Would like to invite your CTO (or their delegate) and the engineer who owns the routing stack.

Propose two quick asks from your side before the demo:
1) Confirm which stakeholders should attend (CTO, Eng Lead, Security contact).
2) Any must-have discussion points (SLA, on-prem, KMS) we should prioritize.

I can run a compact 30-min session that covers: 5-min tailored recap, 15-min demo (live), 8-min Q&A + next steps.

Below are three candidate time windows — please pick one or suggest alternatives:
- Option A: Tue May 20 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Tue May 20 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Option C: Wed May 21 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT

I attached a short 1-page demo synopsis and a blank mutual action plan you can review ahead of the call.

Attachments: 30m-demo-synopsis.pdf (1‑pager), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (template)

Thanks — I’ll hold Option B provisionally for now.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks, Priyom — good recap.

A few notes:
- We want our CTO, Tom Ellis, and our infra lead, Giselle Park, to join. I’m looping Tom if he’s OK to be added.
- Constraint: Tuesdays are tricky after 3pm for our team (all-hands prep). Morning slots are safest on our side.

Can you do any morning slots on Wed or Thu? If not, please propose a morning alternative. Also, we have a short security questionnaire — can you flag who on your team handles SOC2/audit questions so Tom can consider inviting them?

Samira
Samira Khan

samira.k@opslane.io | +1 (617) 555-9923

Yes — mornings work for our team too. Revised options with mornings prioritized:
- Option 1: Wed May 21 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT (matches one of my earlier options)
- Option 2: Thu May 22 — 8:30–9:00 AM PT (early shift)
- Option 3: Thu May 22 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT

We’ll have: myself (demo), Marissa (product brief / roadmap), and Neha (security & compliance) on the call. Neha will handle the SOC2/q control questions you mentioned.

Attaching the 1-page synopsis again and the mutual action plan template for Tom to glance at. When you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a prep doc link.

Attachments: 30m-demo-synopsis.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Best,
Priyom
